entries.question: Shipping tracking and where to send bug reports?
entries.teaser: UPS ships units; tracking arrives by email — report bugs in General or Beta Support.
entries.answerHtml: Units ship via UPS. The team emails you; tracking can take a while. For bugs, post in General or your personal Beta Support group.

entries.question: Device just arrived — what next?
entries.teaser: Send your SN, wait for our push notice, then follow Checklist_revised.pdf.
entries.answerHtml:
Send your device serial number (SN) in General or your private Beta Support group so we can push firmware to your unit.

Pause until we notify you that the firmware update has been pushed.

Then open Announcements and follow Checklist_revised.pdf (plus QuickStart / Checklist as needed). After updating, keep app and firmware current; unbind and re-pair if the screen still needs a sync.
entries.teaserHtml: Send your <mark>SN</mark>, wait for our push notice, then follow <mark>Checklist_revised.pdf</mark>.

entries.question: Recording shows, but nothing returns — or stuck on firmware 1.0.68?
entries.teaser: Send your SN, wait for our firmware-push notice, then follow Checklist_revised.pdf.
entries.answerHtml:
Devices often ship on older firmware (including 1.0.68). Send your device serial number (SN) in General or your private Beta Support group.

Wait for our notification that the new firmware was pushed to your unit — do not assume the app Firmware Update screen shows it immediately.

After that notice, open Announcements and follow Checklist_revised.pdf (use the TestFlight app build the checklist names). After the update, keep app and firmware current; then unbind and re-pair if data needs to sync to the Flip screen.
entries.teaserHtml: Send your <mark>SN</mark>, wait for our firmware-push notice, then follow <mark>Checklist_revised.pdf</mark>.

entries.question: Which iOS app build should I use?
entries.teaser: Install the listed TestFlight build for iOS beta.

entries.question: Calendar in app but not on device — or BT connected with no voice actions?
entries.teaser: Usually an app + firmware version issue — share SN if asked, then wait for our push.
entries.answerHtml: This is usually an app + firmware version issue. Send your serial number (SN) if asked, then wait for our notification that a firmware update has been pushed. After the push, calendars listed in the app should be able to sync to the device. Android / Fold calendar feedback is noted; no commitment yet.

entries.question: Why are there characters in other languages in the UI or AI output?
entries.teaser: AI language/prompt bug under fix — send a screenshot if it returns.
entries.answerHtml: Characters in other languages in the UI or AI output are treated as an AI language / prompt bug. The team is optimizing prompts. If you still see it, send a screenshot in General or your personal Beta Support group.
entries.teaserHtml: AI language/prompt bug under fix — send a screenshot if it returns.

entries.question: Can I leave recording on all day?
entries.teaser: Yes — it only keeps speech and clears after phone sync.
entries.answerHtml: Yes — leave it on. It only keeps audio when someone is speaking. After sync to your phone, device storage clears automatically.

entries.question: Can I use Flip with other AIs via MCP under the NDA?
entries.teaser: MCP with other AIs is allowed in this beta.
entries.answerHtml: MCP is part of the beta; it is fine to try with other AIs.

entries.answerHtml: Your private thread for shipment, serial number (SN), and one-to-one issues.

entries.question: Docs and what to include when reporting
entries.teaser: Include SN, versions, and a screenshot; checklists live in Announcements.
entries.answerHtml: Announcements has Checklist.pdf, QuickStartGuide.pdf, and Checklist_revised.pdf after firmware pushes. Reports help most with repro steps, serial number (SN), app + firmware versions, and a screenshot or short video.
